document.status: CHK-RS-01 REQUIRED; G NOW S4S 15/16 X 4-1/2 X 75; G THICKNESS/WIDTH/LENGTH FIT D-101J; OTHER LS-05 GATES UNCHANGED

rules.panel_shop_billet_rule: For M, D, G, and H only, the first-crosscut shop billet is the finished panel length plus 1 inch. This is 1/2 inch longer than the LS-05 controlled panel rough blank.
rules.frame_shop_billet_rule: The LS-05 rail blanks are 16-1/4 inches, equal to the 15-1/4-inch finished shoulder length plus 1 inch. The muntin blank is 12 inches, equal to its 11-inch finished length plus 1 inch. Do not add another inch.
rules.layout_rule: Complete CHK-RS-01 at full length. Mark checks, knots, pith, metal, and unstable grain on both faces and both edges. Establish clear envelopes from the defect map; do not blindly measure a repeating pattern from a rough end.
rules.end_check_rule: Mark the visible end of every check, move at least 1 inch farther into sound wood, crosscut, and inspect the new end. Repeat if the check remains. Each listed billet length is a minimum clear length after all rejected end-check material.
rules.end_reserve_rule: The 2-inch value is one shared planning reserve for both ends of an entire noncritical board, not 2 inches per billet. Actual rejected material controls.
rules.kerf_rule: Place the full saw kerf on the waste or remainder side of every billet line. The diagrams count 1/8 inch per billet-severing cut and exclude additional defect-isolation cuts.
rules.label_rule: Before separating a billet, mark its STOCK letter, billet identifier, purpose, show-face candidate, reference-edge candidate, and grain direction on both faces. Re-mark immediately after every milling operation.
rules.scope_rule: Every A-O billet, tail, offcut, coupon, and reserve remains door-only stock. None is released to the moulding package.
rules.no_resaw_rule: No resaw operation is permitted. Do not divide any board or billet through its thickness. Prepare each 5/16-inch face from one whole-thickness piece by staged flattening, ordinary face planing, resting, and verified carrier use below normal planer capacity.
rules.stile_rule: Keep B, C, I, and K full length. B and C each supply one 4-3/8 x 81-1/8 face. I and K must each prove 8-7/8 inches of clear jointed width before one full-length width rip creates two 4-3/8-inch lanes plus the 1/8-inch kerf.
rules.short_core_rule: Do not crosscut J or L until the revised CM-05 is signed. L is now 6 inches wide after edge cleanup. J carries three 16-1/4-inch core billets for C, M, and the 6-1/2-inch F stave plus one 12-inch G billet. L carries four 16-1/4-inch billets for E, the 5-inch and 2-1/4-inch D staves, and the 5-3/4-inch F stave. J must prove one clear 6-1/2-inch jointed width envelope.
rules.face_pool_rule: Do not cut short-frame faces until FP-05 assigns up to two M tail billets after D-101H, D/H tails, eligible C/J/L width offcuts, and the required clear 16-1/4-inch mother billets from knot-mapped E/F to every SF/BF strip and required seam. Keep A intact unless a signed substitution is necessary.
rules.zero_spare_release_rule: STOCK-M adds a useful panel and face-stock reserve and STOCK-N/O add uncut short-core reserve, but none relax structural gates. Survey all A-O first; then prove full-length B/C face yield and I/K two-lane yield before releasing any M/D/G/H panel crosscut or any E/F/J/L short-member cut.
rules.staged_milling_rule: Never mill all stock to final size in one pass. Flatten one face, rest and recheck, plane the opposite face parallel, joint one edge, record actual dressed thickness/width/clear length, and stop at the controlled rough size until the next gate passes.
rules.machine_minimum_rule: Never surface a billet shorter or thinner than the machine manufacturer's safe minimum. Keep a longer mother piece or use a verified carrier/sled and guarded procedure when required.
rules.stock_a_damage_rule: STOCK-A's original 78-3/4-inch length is obsolete for cutting. Use 72-3/4 inches after the required 6-inch damage removal. Inspect the new end, exclude any continuation of the defect, and keep A full length as reserve while STOCK-M carries D-101H.
rules.stock_m_rule: STOCK-M is reported finished white oak at 3/4 x 8-1/4 x 99 inches. Verify the actual envelope, moisture, straightness, grain, and clear zones. Cut three 16-1/16-inch D-101H shop billets only after the long-stock gates pass; protect the 48-7/16-inch planning tail. After D-101H passes, FP-05 may release up to two 16-1/4-inch face-pool billets.
rules.stock_n_o_rule: STOCK-N and STOCK-O are confirmed finished white oak at 1-3/4 x 11 x 74 inches each. Keep both full length. Record moisture, grain, flatness, defects, and clear yield under CHK-RS-01. Their 74-inch length cannot yield an 81-inch stile layer; prefer them only as signed short-member core reserve.
rules.stock_g_s4s_rule: STOCK-G is confirmed S4S at 15/16 x 4-1/2 x 75 inches. Its thickness exceeds the 5/8-inch rough-panel minimum by 5/16 inch. Four 16-9/16-inch shop billets plus four 1/8-inch kerfs leave 8-1/4 inches before the one shared 2-inch end reserve and 6-1/4 inches after it. The four current widths total 18 inches, which exceeds the 16-3/8-inch rough panel width by 1-5/8 inches. Thickness, width, and length pass; sign CHK-P-01 before crosscutting.

boards.label: A
boards.raw_dimensions: 1 x 5-11/16 x 72-3/4 current after 6-inch damage removal
boards.action: NO CUT - KEEP FULL 72-3/4 INCHES AS RESERVE
boards.later_pattern: Inspect and map the shortened board, then keep it intact as a D-101H substitution, short-face, coupon, setup, or repair reserve. Cut only under a signed remap if STOCK-M or another assigned source fails.
boards.hold_reason: Six inches are already charged to damage removal. STOCK-M now carries D-101H, so do not consume A preemptively.

boards.label: B
boards.later_pattern: After CHK-ST-01, flatten and joint one continuous 4-3/8-inch lane, rest it, then plane the whole-thickness board in staged carrier-supported passes. Trim only after it proves the 5/16 x 4-3/8 x 81-1/8 D-101A show-face envelope.
boards.hold_reason: The hinge-stile show face must remain continuous. Full-length clear yield and thin-stock carrier control must be proved before trimming.

boards.label: C
boards.later_pattern: After CHK-ST-01, establish one continuous 4-3/8-inch D-101B show-face lane and preserve its longitudinal width offcut for FP-05. Plane eligible pieces from whole thickness in staged carrier-supported passes; trim the stile face only after it proves 5/16 x 4-3/8 x 81-1/8.
boards.hold_reason: Only 2 inches of raw length exceed the face target. One 1/8-inch end cut leaves 1-7/8 inches for both squared ends, so actual clear length controls.

boards.label: D
boards.action: CUT ONLY AFTER CHK-RS-01 + CHK-ST-01 + CHK-ST-02 PASS

cut_now.purpose: D-101K and D-101L lower-panel staves; pair two per 7-3/8-inch rough-width panel

boards.later_pattern: Keep the tail intact. Only after both lower panels pass and FP-05 is signed, cut one clear 16-1/4-inch D-FACE mother billet and plane it from whole thickness to 5/16.
boards.hold_reason: This is the tightest first-cut board; preserve the tail until both lower panels pass.

boards.label: E
boards.later_pattern: Photograph and map every knot, check, and clear zone. FP-05 provisionally assigns three clear 16-1/4-inch face mother billets here, but may shift billets between E and F while preserving at least five accepted billets combined.
boards.hold_reason: Knot locations are unknown. No cut is released until five combined E/F clear envelopes and all face-strip destinations are signed.

boards.label: F
boards.later_pattern: Photograph and map every knot, check, and clear zone. FP-05 provisionally assigns two clear 16-1/4-inch face mother billets here, but may shift billets between F and E while preserving at least five accepted billets combined.
boards.hold_reason: Knot locations are unknown. No cut is released until five combined E/F clear envelopes and all face-strip destinations are signed.

boards.label: G
boards.raw_dimensions: S4S 15/16 x 4-1/2 x 75 current; original rough entry 1 x 4-7/8 x 78-1/4
boards.action: THICKNESS/WIDTH/LENGTH PASS - CUT ONLY AFTER CHK-P-01 + CHK-ST-01 + CHK-ST-02 PASS

cut_now.purpose: D-101J center-panel staves for a 16-3/8-inch rough-width glue-up

boards.later_pattern: Retain the complete remainder for panel substitutions, same-stock coupons, setup pieces, or repair stock.
boards.hold_reason: The confirmed 15/16-inch S4S thickness exceeds the 5/8-inch minimum by 5/16 inch, and width/length pass. CHK-P-01 must still prove flatness, moisture, grain, defects, and four clear billet zones. Do not rip width; remove only enough from the S4S edges to make sound glue joints.

boards.label: H
boards.action: CUT ONLY AFTER CHK-RS-01 + CHK-ST-01 + CHK-ST-02 PASS AND H THICKNESS / WARP SURVEY

cut_now.purpose: D-101N lower-center-panel staves for a 16-3/8-inch rough-width glue-up

boards.later_pattern: Keep the tail intact until all three panel billets dress to at least 5/8 inch. After D-101N passes and FP-05 is signed, cut up to two clear 16-1/4-inch H-FACE mother billets and plane them from whole thickness to 5/16.
boards.hold_reason: Raw thickness is only 7/8 inch. The panel has first claim; face-pool billets are conditional on the remaining clear tail.

boards.label: I
boards.later_pattern: Pass CHK-ST-02 at full length and prove at least 8-7/8 inches of clear jointed width. Make one ordinary full-length width rip for two 4-3/8-inch lanes plus the 1/8-inch kerf. Plane one lane to the D-101B 7/8-inch core and the parallel lane to the D-101B 5/16-inch back face; face clear length is 81-1/8 and governs.
boards.hold_reason: Both continuous lock-stile layers depend on the same board and on the 8-7/8-inch jointed-width gate. Crosscutting first destroys the approved two-lane strategy.

boards.label: J
boards.action: NO CUT UNTIL CHK-SM-01 AND SIGNED CM-05 CORE/OFFCUT MAP
boards.later_pattern: After revised CM-05 proves one clear 6-1/2-inch jointed width envelope, cut three 16-1/4-inch mother billets for D-101C-CORE, D-101M-CORE, and the 6-1/2-inch D-101F-CORE wide stave, plus one 12-inch D-101G-CORE billet. Plane cores to 7/8 and retain every usable longitudinal width offcut for FP-05.
boards.hold_reason: J is now the only no-purchase source for the 6-1/2-inch F core stave displaced from L. The named core pattern, the clear 6-1/2-inch width envelope, and every credited offcut must be drawn, dimensioned, and signed before crosscutting.

boards.label: K
boards.later_pattern: Pass CHK-ST-02 at full length and prove at least 8-7/8 inches of clear jointed width. Make one ordinary full-length width rip for two 4-3/8-inch lanes plus the 1/8-inch kerf. Plane one lane to the D-101A 7/8-inch core and the parallel lane to the D-101A 5/16-inch back face; face clear length is 81-1/8 and governs.
boards.hold_reason: This is the most length-critical board and still must pass the 8-7/8-inch jointed-width gate: the face target and one 1/8-inch end cut leave only 1-1/4 inches total for both squared ends.

boards.label: L
boards.raw_dimensions: 1-5/16 x 6 x 80 current after edge cleanup
boards.action: NO CUT UNTIL CHK-SM-01 AND SIGNED CM-05 CORE/OFFCUT MAP
boards.later_pattern: After revised CM-05 is signed, cut four 16-1/4-inch mother billets for D-101E-CORE, the 5-inch and 2-1/4-inch D-101D-CORE staves, and the 5-3/4-inch D-101F-CORE top stave. Plane cores to 7/8 and retain every usable longitudinal width offcut for FP-05. L is not authorized for any 6-1/2-inch billet.
boards.hold_reason: The original 7-inch width is obsolete. The current 6-inch width forces the revised J/L swap; the named core pattern, D/F seam directions, and every credited width offcut must be drawn, dimensioned, and signed before crosscutting.

boards.label: M
boards.action: CUT ONLY AFTER CHK-RS-01 + CHK-ST-01 + CHK-ST-02 PASS AND M FINISHED-STOCK SURVEY

cut_now.purpose: D-101H upper-panel staves for a 16-3/8-inch rough-width glue-up

boards.later_pattern: Keep the tail intact. Only after D-101H passes and FP-05 proves clear envelopes may up to two 16-1/4-inch M-FACE mother billets be cut and planed from whole thickness to 5/16.
boards.hold_reason: Reported finished dimensions do not replace a shop survey. Verify at least 5/8-inch recoverable thickness, three clear panel envelopes, and sufficient aggregate jointed width before cutting.

boards.label: N
boards.action: NO CUT - KEEP FULL 74 INCHES AS SHORT-MEMBER RESERVE
boards.later_pattern: After CHK-RS-01 confirms clear physical yield and a signed CM-05 fallback is required, N may supply short-member 7/8-inch core billets. Do not use it for a continuous stile layer, and do not plane it to 5/16-inch face or 5/8-inch panel stock without a documented waste review.
boards.hold_reason: The finished-white-oak board is only 74 inches long and cannot replace an 81-inch stile layer; preserve its wide, thick envelope for a short-core failure.

boards.label: O
boards.action: NO CUT - KEEP FULL 74 INCHES AS SHORT-MEMBER RESERVE
boards.later_pattern: After CHK-RS-01 confirms clear physical yield and a signed CM-05 fallback is required, O may supply short-member 7/8-inch core billets, coupons, or repair stock. Do not use it for a continuous stile layer, and do not plane it to 5/16-inch face or 5/8-inch panel stock without a documented waste review.
boards.hold_reason: The finished-white-oak board is only 74 inches long and cannot replace an 81-inch stile layer; preserve its wide, thick envelope for a short-core failure.
